property_summary: Only the owner can withdraw funds: for any caller and any withdraw amount, after funding the contract the correct contract C preserves that only the deployer (owner) can reduce contract balance via withdraw, whereas the mutant allowing anyone to call withdraw can make the contract balance decrease when a non-owner calls withdraw.
change_summary: Relax onlyOwner by allowing any caller (remove the require), changing which accounts can call withdraw and thus what balance is transferred when withdraw is invoked.
